item.description:
EasyReels 0.3.1

A safety setting for the optional cloud model, and a tidy-up underneath.

  • A ceiling on what a cloud model may spend. Settings › Model now caps how many billed calls one run can make. Reading a sermon normally takes two or three; past the limit the run stops rather than carrying on billing. Only applies if you have chosen Claude or ChatGPT — Apple Intelligence is free and unmetered.
  • The release tooling is ready for a signed, notarized build, so the first-launch warning can go away once the developer account is in place.
  • Removed a menu command that wrote an FFmpeg script the app renders better itself, plus a few hundred lines nothing was using.
